name: Material Receiving & Spectro QA
description: Certified structural steel tubes (S275/S355) undergo optical spectrometry and tensile stress testing upon arrival.

name: CNC High-Tension Profiling
description: Sub-millimeter automated laser and rotary tube cutting ensuring accurate cuplock node placements and clean bevel angles.

name: Multi-Axis Robotic Welding
description: Automated welding cells delivering full-penetration seams tested against cyclic vibration and extreme load concentrations.

name: Thermal Dip Galvanizing & Coating
description: Immersion in molten zinc baths (≥ 65-85 µm) providing decades of corrosion resistance in aggressive desert and marine environments.

name: Hydraulic Load Proof Testing
description: Calibrated hydraulic rigs perform destructive and non-destructive load tests ensuring compliance with SASO and European norms.

name: Barcoded Staging & Rapid Dispatch
description: Individual batches are barcoded, certified, strapped, and dispatched directly onto dedicated heavy logistics flatbeds.
